provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A module is loaded from a non-literal path, so the argument can select an arbitrary file.

groundTruth.rationale: require with a variable argument resolves whatever path the caller supplies, which allows loading of unintended modules.

limitations: Line-level lexical only; whether the variable is attacker-controlled is not proven.
Matches the loader call shape; bundler-resolved static requires never match.
The matched text is the loader prefix only (require plus one non-literal char), so the assertion pins that prefix.
